finding: FUZZ-M10-24H-B (the final-tree 24 h run at 4f4849e, `--profile all --seed 20261004 --actions 400`, mock seed 20301612, 1 in 52,272 wind-downs; harness, not program): a `config_change` raised `settle_persist_n` to 320, a short opened and locked it (`ShortPosition::settle_persist_n`, read by `sol_settle` through `engine::arming::terms`), a second `config_change` lowered the config's to 40. In the wind-down the position stayed armed on the S1/S2 legs on the undisturbed mock (at the end, past its deadline: `close_short` InsufficientVault, `liquidate` UseSolSettle, `expire` UseLiquidate); every per-second `sol_settle` landed as a keep, but the wind-down's `persist_seconds` sized its per-second coverage from the config (40 + 30 = 70 s) and its other keeper seconds ran at most 159 in a row before a deadline or day warp broke the arm gap, so the 320 EMA updates were never reached (s_count 894 at ema_count 963: 69 updates). A real keeper keeps an armed position on the per-second cadence until it settles. Replay: `shortwin-fuzz replay tests/fuzz/corpus/fuzz-m10-24h-b-mock-locked-persist.json`; the full run: `one --profile mock --seed 20301612 --actions 400` (338 actions).
